description: Implementation of the ru_dummy_impl class managing slot timing, sector coordination, and loop execution for a radio system simulation or processing module.

classes.name: ru_dummy_impl
classes.description: Class implementing dummy radio unit behavior, managing slots, sectors, and timing notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the system slot and starts sector operations, then begins the main loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all sectors and signals the termination of the main loop.

methods.name: defer_loop
methods.description: Schedules the main loop to run asynchronously unless a stop is requested.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main execution loop that updates slot timing, sends notifications, and manages sector boundaries.
